headline: SFG @ MIL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is SFG 3.37 at MIL 5.73, with a projected total of 9.11. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward MIL: SFG moved +0.20 runs while MIL moved +1.92, changing the projected margin by -1.72 runs. The projected total climbed +2.12, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +10.9%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: detailed outing logs were not available for every pitcher, so the page separates actual outings from analyzer L3/L5/L10 windows instead of treating those windows as box scores. Batter research is strongest for Jung Hoo Lee, William Contreras, Jackson Chourio, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Buddy Kennedy, Blake Perkins because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
